evals.prompt: Run a file-size report on this project and tell me which files are oversized.
evals.expected_output: Emits the 4-file Vue 3 page with size distribution, top-N largest files, and oversize flags.
expectations: Walks the scope and collects per-file bytes/lines/type/mtime
Aggregates directory sums, top-N largest, oversize flags
Emits index.html + index.js + index.css + data.js

evals.prompt: Give me a project treemap of disk usage by directory.
evals.expected_output: The Vue 3 page with a size-distribution section including directory-level sums and a histogram.
expectations: Aggregates directory-level size sums
Computes a type breakdown and histogram
Byte-stable index.html/index.js/index.css copied verbatim from templates

evals.prompt: Analyze dependency depth across this codebase.
evals.expected_output: Runs nesting-depth analysis via DFS with memoization and reports max-depth per file + aggregate stats.
expectations: Extracts imports via per-language import regex
Computes nesting depth via DFS with memoization
Flags files exceeding the depth>15 critical threshold

evals.prompt: Detect import cycles in this project and suggest fixes.
evals.expected_output: Runs 3-color DFS cycle detection and lists cycle paths with suggested fixes.
expectations: Detects cycles via 3-color DFS
Outputs cycle paths with suggested fixes
Truncates to top-200 by severity if cycle count exceeds 200

evals.prompt: Which files in this repo haven't been touched in over a year?
evals.expected_output: Freshness analysis with age buckets and top-N stale files.
expectations: Computes asOf = max(lastModified)
Buckets files by age
Lists top-N stale files

evals.prompt: Show me the fan-in / fan-out hotspot report for this codebase.
evals.expected_output: A dependency-graph section with fan-in/fan-out and hotspot scores per file.
expectations: Builds an adjacency list from import extraction
Computes fan-in / fan-out per file
Computes hotspot scores and flags hotspot >= 5.0 as critical

evals.prompt: Run the full 6-stage analysis pipeline on this scope.
evals.expected_output: Walks scope, computes size, dependency graph, depth, cycles, freshness, and emits the 4-file Vue 3 page.
expectations: Runs all six stages in order: inventory, size, graph, depth, cycles, freshness
Regenerates only data.js on rerun
Reads source files read-only (no modifications)

evals.prompt: The scope path /tmp/missing doesn't exist — what happens?
expectations: Aborts with scope-not-found
Does not emit partial report files
Surfaces the invalid path to the user

evals.expected_output: Emits the report using the light theme.
expectations: Applies the light theme
Falls back to dark with a stderr warning if theme is unknown
Still emits all 4 files

evals.prompt: My project has a 2500-LOC file — what severity is that?
evals.expected_output: Classifies the file as Critical (P0) per the >1000 LOC threshold.
expectations: Applies the severity-level rubric
Flags the file as Critical (P0) marker
Includes the file in the oversized-files section
